title.en: Oceans and continents of the Earth

text.en:
From a spaceship window, an astronaut saw the Earth as a blue ball with brown and green patches.
"The blue is water and the patches are land," she told the children on a video call. "Most of our planet is covered by oceans."

About 71 percent of the Earth is covered with water and about 29 percent is land. That is why the Earth is called the blue planet.
The large pieces of land are continents. There are seven: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia. Asia is the largest and Australia is the smallest.
The big water bodies are oceans. There are five: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic oceans. The Pacific Ocean is the largest and the Arctic Ocean is the smallest.
India is in the continent of Asia. The Indian Ocean lies to its south, with the Bay of Bengal on the east and the Arabian Sea on the west.
Oceans give us food, salt, minerals and rain, and ships carry goods across them.
About seventy-one percent of the Earth is water, so it is called the blue planet.
There are seven continents. Asia is the largest and Australia the smallest.
There are five oceans. The Pacific is the largest and the Arctic is the smallest.
India is in Asia. The Indian Ocean is to its south.

problem.en: Count the continents and oceans, and name the largest of each.

why.en: It has the biggest area of land.

text.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean.

why.en: It is bigger than all other oceans.

prompt.en: A friend thinks land covers more of the Earth than water. How will you correct him?

requiredIdeas.en: About 71 percent of the Earth is water and 29 percent is land.
So water covers more of the Earth.

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking land is the bigger part.

points.en: Water covers about 71 percent of the Earth.
Asia and the Pacific Ocean are the largest.
